creditsPage.crawlIntro: A long time ago, in a galaxy of logs far, far away…

aboutPage.lead: The path of every request through the logs: where it came from, which systems it passed, where it waited and where it stopped.

what.title: What it is
what.text: A service for viewing logs. It finds records by a value and a period, groups them into requests and shows the path of a request step by step. Threadline only reads logs and changes nothing in them.

why.title: Why
why.text: To sort out a case: open it, enter a value, see the reason, leave.

whom.title: For whom
whom.text: For those who handle support cases and work with projects. A role decides what each of them sees and can do.
